key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with the economy 'limping along' (Headlines 35, 75)
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price falls (Headlines 64, 66)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle (Headlines 37, 69)
Bathla collapse signals broader construction sector fragility; ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt (Headlines 31, 32, 38)
EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time in Australia, driven by soaring fuel costs (Headline 28)
AI/tech momentum persists: Nvidia, Broadcom signal continued AI revenue ramp; data centre backlash grows (Headlines 72, 56, 70)
ASIC launches whistleblower review of Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns (Headline 39)
ASX small-caps active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche among weekly runners; Aurum adds gold ounces (Headlines 25, 26)

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout obscured by war-driven demand; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength. Macarthur clears WA bulk test. Aurum adds high-grade gold ounces.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore oversupply. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows. Small-cap miners offer speculative upside but carry elevated execution risk.

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks project record house price declines. CBA and WBC exploit fee loopholes on loyal customers. ASIC whistleblower review of Big Four adds governance overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression and credit cycle risk. Fee controversy may trigger regulatory action. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by falling property values.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo flagged to challenge gas cartel pricing. Energy transition costs mounting as infrastructure lags. EV adoption accelerates but hidden costs emerge.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, SXG.AX, BOQ.AX benefit from gas price strength. EV transition supports long-term demand but near-term capex risk. Watch LNG contract renegotiation dynamics.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. Ultragenyx shares crash 44% to record low. CSL remains a defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX retains defensive appeal. Global biotech volatility (ULTR) signals risk-off in growth. Domestic healthcare (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) relatively insulated.

sectors.trend: Nvidia and Broadcom confirm AI revenue ramp continues. Data centre backlash intensifies in Australia. Nvidia's $5B Intel bet valued at $30B. Silver ETFs (SIVR, SLVP) attract flows.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI capex supports hardware supply chains. Data centre opposition may delay Australian infrastructure projects. Monitor ASX-listed tech enablers.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse exposes construction sector fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower. Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth. Carla Zampatti acquires Brighton retail space.
sectors.implications: WBC.AX, CBA.AX construction lending at risk. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) face valuation pressure. Selective retail property (Brighton) shows blue-chip resilience.

Housing downturn: record price falls forecast, loan applications collapsing (64, 66, 36)

EV transition inflection point in Australia (28, 34)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); reduce leverage; monitor CPI and employment data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit cycle downturn and construction defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight construction-linked lending; diversify away from residential REITs; monitor NIM trends at CBA.AX, WBC.AX
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Victoria sovereign debt and fiscal sustainability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor ratings agency actions; avoid Victoria-domiciled infrastructure bonds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory/governance shock from ASIC Big Four review
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor audit quality disclosures; favour companies with independent audit committees

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and gas cartel dynamics
risk_assessment.mitigation: Track WES.AX, SXG.AX gas contract renewals; assess Beetaloo (BTL.AX) competitive positioning

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and iron ore shakeout rotation
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore structural oversupply pressures BHP/RIO/FMG; gold benefits from rate uncertainty and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on exploration catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals showing momentum; Aurum adding gold ounces

opportunities.recommendation: Position for gas price strength via ASX energy names
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rates surging; Beetaloo challenging cartel; energy transition costs support gas demand
CSL.AX offers earnings visibility amid macro uncertainty; global biotech volatility (Ultragenyx -44%) makes domestic healthcare attractive

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and construction-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price falls forecast; Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; loan applications down 15%

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore-heavy mining positions; diversify into gold and lithium
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore shakeout structural; war-driven demand masking underlying oversupply

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds and quality defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA may hike further despite stalling economy; Victoria debt concerns add sovereign risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank fee controversy for regulatory escalation risk
defensive_moves.rationale: CBA/WBC fee loophole may trigger ASIC or Treasury intervention, creating reputational and compliance costs

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA rate uncertainty and housing credit contraction dominate. Iron ore weakness and construction sector stress weigh on materials and financials. Gold and gas names offer relative strength. Expect volatility around RBA communications and CPI prints.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in iron ore demand and housing cycle suggest a re-rating of traditional ASX heavyweights. AI capex super-cycle and EV transition provide secular growth pockets. Australia's per-capita GDP stagnation vs Canada signals need for productivity reform. Energy transition and gas pricing will be key 12-month themes.
